metadata.title: LakeWatch Laguna – LLDA historical water-quality observations
metadata.provenance: Official LLDA quarterly reports: Q4 2023 and Q2 2026, historical laboratory observations; not real-time, no API connection.
metadata.coordinateDisclaimer: Nine station coordinates taken from published academic Appendix A (2–3 decimals; not certified LLDA GPS), seven approximate regional locations interpreted from LLDA maps, three unlocated historical identifiers. Exact official LLDA GPS files are not publicly verified.
metadata.mapReference: LLDA Quarterly Water Quality Report October–December 2023, page 1 station-location figure
metadata.licenseNote: LLDA is identified as the original data provider. This academic app is not affiliated with or endorsed by LLDA.
metadata.stationNetworkNote: 16 numbered lake stations appear in the LLDA April–June 2026 report. Roman numerals III, VI and VII are not listed in the 2026 lake table. Counts exclude tributary river stations.
metadata.networkScope: 16 stations with confirmed June 2026 reporting records, plus III/VI/VII as unlocated and unverified historical identifiers. Unlocated identifiers do not represent confirmed extant physical stations.
metadata.establishmentScope: Year of inclusion only where expressly documented: 2012 and 2021; day/month generally not documented. Do not confuse earliest documented appearance with formal establishment date.
metadata.statusDefinition: Active = June 2026 station reading in imported LLDA Q2 report; Archived = no June 2026 reading in this application. Archived does not establish LLDA closure/decommissioning.

parameters.name: Dissolved Oxygen
parameters.description: Oxygen dissolved in the water, important for aquatic life.

parameters.name: Biochemical Oxygen Demand
parameters.description: Oxygen consumed by microorganisms breaking down organic matter.

parameters.name: pH Level
parameters.description: Acidity or alkalinity measured on the pH scale.

parameters.name: Nitrate
parameters.description: A nitrogen nutrient measured in lake water.

parameters.name: Inorganic Phosphate
parameters.description: Phosphorus nutrient measured in the water.

parameters.name: Total Suspended Solids
parameters.description: Mass of suspended solid material per volume of water.
